classification.difficultyReason: Use standard tens stems and ordered unit leaves, then directly apply the named mean, median and range procedures; the plot supplies an ordered list for finding the median.

inlines.text: The numbers of Tasmanian devils that crossed a particular road over a number of weeks are recorded in the table below.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Draw a stem-and-leaf plot of the data.

inlines.text: Use the tens digit as the stem and the units digit as the leaf. List leaves in ascending order, retaining repeated values.
means 24 Tasmanian devils. The plot contains 19 leaves, one for each week.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the mean, median and range of this data. Give the mean correct to 2 decimal places.

answer.short: Mean $\approx34.16$ Tasmanian devils per week; median $=36$ Tasmanian devils; range $=24$ Tasmanian devils.
answer.worked:
There are 19 observations with total 649.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Mean}&=\frac{649}{19}\\\text{Mean}&\approx34.16\text{ Tasmanian devils per week}\end{align*}$$

The ordered data are 22, 23, 24, 24, 26, 27, 31, 33, 35, 36, 38, 38, 39, 40, 41, 41, 41, 44, 46. The middle observation is the 10th.

$$\text{Median}=36\text{ Tasmanian devils}$$

$$\begin{align*}\text{Range}&=46-22\\\text{Range}&=24\text{ Tasmanian devils}\end{align*}$$
